The '''Rusty Cog''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[the Mountain]]s, [[Hoes|digging]] up sand tiles in [[the Mines]] or [[Skull Cavern]], or from [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] or [[Artifact Trove]]s. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

==Tailoring==
Rusty Cog is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Circuitboard Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt234.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Rusty Cog is not used in any [[quests]].
